items.title: Orders reach the warehouse on time
items.problem: Late order exports delayed 4 dispatch waves in September 2026.

drivers.statement: Late dispatch breaks the next-day delivery promise

items.outcome: Every order reaches the warehouse within 5 minutes of payment.

items.title: Exports arrive within 5 minutes
items.metric: Share of exports that arrive within 5 minutes, export audit table

items.title: Reliable export worker
items.description: An export worker that processes each order once and on time, under release changes.
items.benefit_hypothesis: We believe a reliable worker will raise on-time exports; we will know when the 5-minute share reaches 99.5%.

items.title: Exports retry a failed warehouse call 3 times
items.i_want: to retry a failed warehouse call 3 times with backoff
items.so_that: a short warehouse outage does not delay exports

acceptance.given: the warehouse API fails twice and then succeeds
acceptance.then: the order is exported exactly once within 30 seconds

items.title: Export audit row shows the wrong time zone
items.observed: Audit rows show local time without an offset, so lag reads 5 hours 30 minutes too high.
items.expected: Audit rows store UTC with an offset.

acceptance.then: the time ends in Z and matches the export log within 1 second
